paragraphs: Ulla gropes the paths of his mother.
Mentioned in Bava Batra 9b. According to Rashi’s explanation, he is Rav Sheshet; according to Rabbeinu Gershom, he is Rav Achadboi bar Ami. See their entries.

notes.text: Rashi explains the woman as Rav Sheshet’s mother; Rabbeinu Gershom calls her Rav Achadboi’s mother and Rav Sheshet’s wetnurse.
The frozen Hyman heading has מגשש (“gropes”), whereas the Gemara and both commentaries have משגש (“disturbs”). The frozen Hebrew is unchanged pending a source-image check.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume III, printed p. 975, confirms the heading מגשש and the reference Bava Batra 9b. The English follows that printed heading; the consulted Gemara reads משגש (“disturbs”). Hyman reports the two commentary identifications. Rashi calls the woman Rav Sheshet’s mother; Rabbeinu Gershom calls her Rav Achadboi’s mother and Rav Sheshet’s wetnurse. These are competing readings of the narrative, not an identification of the two sages with one another. The earlier note’s pending source-image check predates this inspection.
